### [Qwen3.8-Flash-Next](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Aug/26/qwen38-flash-next/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-08-26

Qwen released Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, an open-weights multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model providing an early preview of the upcoming Qwen4 architecture.

- Features 125 billion total parameters with only 6 billion active parameters per token for enhanced performance efficiency.
- Serves as a multimodal MoE model architecture preview for Qwen4.
- Tested on an Nvidia DGX Spark using Unsloth quantized variants, including the 72.5GB UD-IQ1_S and 78.9GB UD-Q2_K_XL models.
- Supports variable reasoning effort levels, including an xhigh reasoning effort setting.

**Why it matters:** It offers high-capacity multimodal performance with low active-parameter inference overhead, allowing large MoE models to run locally on specialized hardware using optimized quantization.

### [Advancing Claude for Education](https://www.anthropic.com/news/advancing-claude-for-education)

**Anthropic** · 2026-08-27

Anthropic announced upcoming Claude for Education features, including Canvas LTI support, Wiley and Panopto integrations via Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, expanded student programs, and new institutional adoptions.

- Integrations with Panopto and Wiley use pre-built Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to pull lecture transcripts and peer-reviewed scientific content directly into Claude conversations.
- Canvas LTI (Learning Tools Interoperability) integration enables students to access Claude directly inside Canvas course environments.
- Student conversations are private by default, excluded from model training, and feature restricted self-serve data exports alongside required formal approval for institutional data requests.
- Institutions like the University of San Francisco School of Law are incorporating Claude into courses (e.g., Evidence) to analyze claims, map evidence, identify discovery gaps, and evaluate trial strategies.

**Why it matters:** Using the Model Context Protocol allows higher education platforms to expose trusted academic sources and course materials directly to LLMs while enforcing strict data privacy standards.
